# sandbox dogfood loop report

The unattended loop ran inside the sandbox: status, next, claim, packet, submit.
The task now sits in needs_review — `apply` is the HUMAN review gate, intentionally
not driven by the agent. Real evidence from the executed verbs follows.

$comment: Deterministic steering sequence for the mock provider: tool call N on request N; $NEXT_TASK_ID resolves from the most recent anvil_next result; the loop ENDS AT SUBMIT (needs_review) because apply is the human review gate; write embeds the submit result as evidence.
